summary: PASS-3 grind (2026-08-05). Re-verified every non-'match' item from the PASS-2 state directly against design/prototype/Clio Session.html's own markup and the LIVE read-only backend's real data (not the prior pass's paraphrase), and closed both remaining real items. Async chip -> 'match': added a new `async` side-by-side.mjs setup (Playwright route-intercepts ONLY the GET .../agent-tasks response with canned rows shaped like the prototype's own demo set — no session/message mutation, same technique as the pre-existing `queue` setup's held-open POSTs) so the popover is now reachable through the sanctioned visual tool instead of an ad-hoc mocked check; that live capture also caught and fixed one more real, previously-unrecorded deviation — the 'run history' link carried an invented uppercase+letter-spacing treatment the prototype's own `goRunHistory` button never has (plain lowercase, 11.5px). Model selector/menu -> 'match': fixed all three items the 2026-08-05 independent audit found. (1) The provider row's per-provider 'default ⌄' config indicator was a straight silent omission — it now renders visible, disabled, and flagged (data-unbacked, red-tinted, titled), the SAME convention as the composer's own attach button, because clio-agent's session-scoped model PATCH has no field to switch among a provider's presets even though the presets themselves ARE real (GET /v1/providers/lm's presets[], several sharing one `provider`, e.g. argonne_metis/argonne_sophia). (2) Provider rows were rebuilt from two stacked lines to the prototype's own one-line `auto minmax(0,1fr) auto` grid, and the panes area was bounded+internally-scrolled (was an unbounded `min-height` only) so the bottom 'thinking' row can no longer be pushed off-screen by a long live catalogue, regardless of provider count. (3) The trigger's 'model not set / model not set' duplication (audit2-fresh.png) is fixed at its root: the picker no longer treats its own empty-value placeholder sentinel as a genuinely selected model/group. Verifying (2) against the REAL ~10-provider live catalogue (not the prototype's 3-item demo) surfaced a FOURTH, previously-unknown defect this same pass caught and fixed: a real provider's long `status_message` ("stored Globus token could not be refreshed; authenticate ALCF", live on argonne_sophia/argonne_metis) blew out the row's grid track sizing and visually swallowed the provider NAME entirely — invisible to jsdom (no layout), only caught via a live Playwright bounding-box probe against the running preview. Fixed by bounding the row's own grid tracks and adding overflow+ellipsis+title to the status text. Two items remain honest, intentional non-matches, re-confirmed unchanged this pass: the attach button (unbacked, correctly flagged) and Shift+Tab (owner-confirmed deliberate addition beyond the prototype). The steering-context panel stays 'missing' — re-swept (grep for onFocusChild/focusedChild/steering across src/), still genuinely absent, still correctly deferred to the E9 Call-agent-grammar cross-cutting work.

items.audit_correction: PASS-3 grind (2026-08-05): fixed all three items the 2026-08-05 independent audit found, then found and fixed a FOURTH while visually re-verifying (2) against the real live catalogue. (1) The per-provider 'default ⌄' config indicator was a silent omission (nothing rendered in its place) — now renders visible, disabled, and flagged (data-unbacked, red-tinted, titled), the same convention as the composer's own attach button and this same popover's per-model gear below it. It stays non-interactive because the underlying mutation path is genuinely session-unsafe to wire, not merely unbuilt: menus-grammar.json independently confirmed live that GET /v1/providers/lm's presets[] CAN carry >1 entry per provider (argonne_metis + argonne_sophia both provider:'argonne'), but the only way to change which one is active is PUT /v1/providers/lm — the GLOBAL daemon config — so a per-session composer control that appeared to 'switch' it would actually silently reconfigure every OTHER session too. (2) Provider rows rebuilt from two stacked lines to the prototype's own one-line `auto minmax(0,1fr) auto` grid; the panes area is now height-capped with its OWN internal scroll (was an unbounded min-height only) so the bottom 'thinking' row can never be pushed off-screen by a long live catalogue again. (3) The trigger's 'model not set / model not set' duplication (audit2-fresh.png) is fixed at the root — the picker no longer treats its own empty-value placeholder sentinel as a genuinely selected model/group (both the trigger-label lookup AND groupsFromOptions' fallback grouping are guarded). Verifying (2) against the REAL ~10-provider live catalogue (not the prototype's 3-item demo) surfaced a fourth, previously-unknown defect: a real provider's long status_message ('stored Globus token could not be refreshed; authenticate ALCF', live on argonne_sophia/argonne_metis) blew out the row's CSS grid track sizing and visually swallowed the provider NAME entirely — invisible in jsdom (no layout), only caught via a live Playwright bounding-box probe against the running preview build. Fixed by bounding the row's grid tracks (`minmax(0,auto) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,72px)`, `min-width:0`) and adding overflow+ellipsis+title to the status text.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/ProviderModelPicker.tsx — provider row now renders `<span providername> <span cfg data-unbacked> <small title=...>`; `selectedGroup`/`selectedModel` and `groupsFromOptions` all guard the empty-value placeholder. apps/web/src/composer/provider-model-picker.css — `.provider-model-picker__provider` is a one-line 3-column grid with bounded/min-width:0 tracks; `.provider-model-picker__panes` is `max-height:240px` with `.provider-model-picker__providers`/`__models` each independently `overflow-y:auto; min-height:0`. Locked by tests/unit/composer-pill-grind.test.tsx: 'model picker — trigger label on a model-less session' (3 tests), 'model picker — provider row grammar' (2 tests: one-line grid, visible/disabled/flagged cfg badge), and the grid-blowout regression lock (full status text reaches the DOM via `title` even once visually clipped). Full suite green (490 tests); build green. Visually verified against the REAL live ~10-provider catalogue (not a mock) via a Playwright bounding-box probe (popover height 313.5px, thinking row fully within the 900px viewport with ~95px to spare) and a cropped screenshot of just the popover, plus the full screenshots/side-by-side/composer-pill-model.png composite.
